segments.an4.63:1.1: “Sabrahmakāni, bhikkhave [itivu.106], tāni kulāni yesaṃ puttānaṃ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
segments.an4.63:1.2: Sapubbācariyakāni, bhikkhave, tāni kulāni, yesaṃ puttānaṃ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
segments.an4.63:1.3: Sapubbadevatāni [sapubbadevāni (syā. kaṃ.)], bhikkhave, tāni kulāni yesaṃ puttānaṃ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
segments.an4.63:1.4: Sāhuneyyakāni, bhikkhave, tāni kulāni yesaṃ puttānaṃ mātāpitaro ajjhāgāre pūjitā honti.
segments.an4.63:2.3: Pubbadevatāti [pubbadevāti (sī. syā. kaṃ.)], bhikkhave, mātāpitūnaṃ etaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
segments.an4.63:2.6: Bahukārā, bhikkhave, mātāpitaro, puttānaṃ āpādakā posakā imassa lokassa dassetāro”ti.
segments.an4.63:4.1: “Tasmā hi ne namasseyya, sakkareyya ca paṇḍito;
segments.an4.63:4.3: Annena atha pānena, vatthena sayanena ca;
segments.an4.63:5.3: Idheva naṃ pasaṃsanti, pecca sagge pamodatī”ti.
